# AIBgin — safe AI for schools (in development)
> AIBgin is in development. It is being built on AIB.core, the engine behind AIBEVA, and is made for the classroom. It is not available for purchase yet.

## Key facts
- Status: in development, not yet available
- Designed for: FERPA, COPPA, KCSiE, EU AI Act, GDPR
- No student accounts by design; QR code access for classes
- Built by SAY TO PAY s.r.o. (AIBlab), Ostrava, Czech Republic, EU
- Available now from the same company: AIBEVA, a personal AI assistant for Windows — https://aibeva.com
- Contact: info@aiblab.info
